description: Open the Ticket of the variable ticket from the Ticket list by its identifier, and wait until every part of its Overview has arrived, as Aura's end-to-end tests do (expectOverviewShown): its details, the CVSS assessments and the sources of its CVE, and its participants. Its waits need a Ticket with a CVE, CVSS assessments, and participants, such as SNTL-12.

steps.caption: Open the Ticket
steps.narration: To open the Ticket, select its identifier.
